evidence: Injected five classes (python3 -I provider_loss_injector.py, exit 0, all five PASS) and ran 17 unittest cases (python3 -I -m unittest discover, 17 tests OK). Killing the whole child worker runtime with SIGKILL immediately after it recorded a provider-reported completion left the event chain at CREATED, LEASED, RUNNING, PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED with no COMPLETED event, no transaction-completed.json, nothing committed under the result slot, zero ingestion records, RESUME_OR_RERUN_FROM_IMMUTABLE_INPUT, an intact capsule and a clean verify_chain; the same loss before any report left no provider claim at all. A document claiming obzio COMPLETED with a null result_commit_id and no artifacts was refused by the seeded contract, including the explicit error that provider completion without a result commit must be PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED; a self-acceptance attempt was refused with 'producer cannot self-accept'; complete_unit refused with 'cannot complete before PARENT_INGESTED'; and ingestion of that shape returned RECOVERY_REQUIRED with 'result carries no artifacts; nothing durable to ingest'. The frozen Code-2 fixture carries exactly provider COMPLETION_REPORTED_OR_LIVE_CONFLICT, Obzio PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED, result UNRECOVERED_AFTER_FOUR_REPORTED_ROUTES and acceptance NOT_ACCEPTED, with four reported routes, a null durable result commit, an empty artifact list, classification PERMANENT_FAULT_FIXTURE and no deliverable claim; it cites workstreams/po03/evidence/so02-operating-correction.json at sha256 646bc5f36f4e18af543364dbfd432ccd7cc4bd7e1d35e229e462ea64ec56b148 and 3904 bytes, verified by re-hashing the read-only file. scan_recovery takes only run_id and head_sha and reads only repository state, so no founder relay is an input to recovery. false_completions_observed was 0.
falsifiable_hypothesis: Entire provider-runtime loss produces PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED, never COMPLETED, and the lost PO-02 Code-2 return is a permanent fault fixture rather than a deliverable.
limitations: The recorded evidence labels two of the four states differently: code2_result_state is UNRECOVERED_AFTER_FOUR_FOUNDER_REPORTED_ROUTES rather than UNRECOVERED_AFTER_FOUR_REPORTED_ROUTES, and code2_acceptance_state is NOT_TESTED rather than NOT_ACCEPTED. Both labels are recorded verbatim in the fixture's state_reconciliation with the commissioned value marked SAME_MEANING_DIFFERENT_LABEL and NARROWER_IN_THE_FIXTURE; the producer did not rewrite the evidence or upgrade either claim.

The four reported routes are historical and were not re-executed; the fixture freezes their recorded outcome and asserts the invariant, it does not re-attempt recovery of the lost Code-2 bytes, which are not present in this repository.
The no-founder-relay finding covers the recovery decision surface (scan_recovery and ingestion inputs); it does not prove that no human is involved anywhere in the wider programme.
provider_run_id is NOT_SUPPORTED because this runtime exposes no subagent spawn tool and therefore no separate provider run identifier.
